spec_match.rationale: Applies domain-specific custom text-overflow delimiter strings (' / …', '/…', ' → …', ' :: …') to repository file paths and breadcrumbs while proving that underlying DOM text remains unmutated.

interactive.rationale: Users can switch hierarchy delimiters, resize column width with a slider, and toggle accessible full-path disclosure panels on every row.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index description: practical developer UI condensing long repository file paths and breadcrumbs with accessible full-path disclosure and screen-reader parity.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers sighted keyboard/touch disclosure when text is visually truncated, plus wide widths where truncation ceases.

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/6294595288825856, CSS Overflow Level 4, and MDN.

conformance.rationale: Verifies both CSS.supports/computed style for delimiter strings and DOM textContent non-mutation.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified delimiter toggling, width resizing, aria-expanded disclosure panels, and zero console or layout issues.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits filepath-condenser-probe telemetry with DOM integrity, active delimiter, column width, and disclosure state.

design_system.rationale: Strict adherence to /public/styles.css variables, paired background+color button rules, and 44px minimum target heights.

accessibility.rationale: Every truncated path row pairs CSS truncation with an aria-expanded/aria-controls disclosure button so sighted keyboard and touch users can read the complete path without hover.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Path frames respect max-width: 100% and word-break: break-all inside expanded disclosures so 360px mobile viewports never overflow horizontally.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never rely solely on hover tooltips to reveal truncated text; provide a keyboard- and touch-accessible disclosure mechanism.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added explicit <button aria-expanded aria-controls> 'Reveal full path' controls on every truncated filepath row.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure all interactive buttons and range sliders have explicit labels and 44px minimum touch targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied min-height: 44px and explicit <label for='col-width'> plus aria-pressed/aria-expanded states across all controls.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prevent long unbroken strings such as file paths and Rust namespaces from causing horizontal overflow on narrow mobile screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied max-width: 100% and box-sizing: border-box on truncated frames and word-break: break-all on expanded disclosure panels.

summary: Practical developer filepath and breadcrumb condenser demonstrating text-overflow: ' / …' paired with accessible keyboard/touch disclosure and DOM integrity checks.
